verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say agents and workflows stream incremental output in real time, and `toAISdkStream()` converts those streams into AI SDK formats for UI consumption. Tool-related events appear in the stream as `tool-call-approval` chunks, and events flow through PubSub so clients can reconnect without missing chunks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tool-call and step event chunk types beyond the approval chunk, and independent hands-on corroboration of UI streaming.
